title: Stop reporting stored evaluations that done cannot consume as fresh in show and next JSON
outcome: Stop reporting stored evaluations that done cannot consume as fresh in show and next JSON
acceptance: For a stored content-fingerprint evaluation under the source-freshness policy, and for a stored git-tree evaluation with freshness off, the show and next JSON no longer present the evaluation as fresh and checked at done when done would refuse it; a behaviour test covers both cases.
